title: failed to get next task: %!w(*fmt.wrapError=&{failed to get next command: no tool calls found 0x14000113a40})
body: The LLM model is trying to choose between available instruments (open a web browser, edit code, execute a shell command, etc.), but sometimes it fails to choose one, and this error occurs. I will open a new GitHub issue.

linked_prs.title: Fix no tools issue
linked_prs.body:
While this fix isn't ideal, it corrects an annoying bug and prevents the loop from hanging. This may require the agent to seek assistance for a longer period, but it should be addressed through other means, such as enhancing the prompt or improving the chat flow, etc.

Close issue #25.

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves the agent's tool invocation process, where the LLM fails to select or call a tool, resulting in an error. This directly relates to agent-specific tool handling and orchestration, fitting the taxonomy under tool invocation and workflow anomalies.
